Here's a summary of the content on this page:

## OIML Certificate of Conformity
**Issuing authority:** NMi (OIML Member State: The Netherlands)

**Certificate details:**
- Number: R76/2006-NL1-17.22
- Project number: 16200726
- Page 2 of 2

**Supporting Test Reports:**
- No. NMi-16200726-01, dated 19 April 2017 (60 pages)
- No. NMi-16200726-02, dated 19 April 2017 (33 pages)

## Characteristics of the non-automatic weighing instrument

| Characteristic | Value |
|---|---|
| Accuracy class | (III) |
| Maximum capacity | 0 ≤ Max ≤ 15 kg |
| Verification scale interval | e ≥ 2 g |
| Weighing range(s) | Multiple range |
| Max. number of scale intervals (multiple range) | n ≤ 3000 divisions (per weighing range) |
| Maximum number of weighing ranges | 2 |
| Tare | T ≤ Max₁ − e₁ for multiple range instruments |
| Temperature range | −10 °C / +40 °C |
| Power supply voltage | 100 – 240 V AC, 50/60 Hz |
| Application | Intended to be used for direct sales to the public |
| Software identification | Version number: 2.00 |

This page confirms conformity under OIML R76 (the international recommendation for non-automatic weighing instruments). The "(III)" class indicates a **medium accuracy commercial scale**, and the "direct sales to the public" designation means it's approved for retail use (e.g., selling goods by weight to customers).
